benchmarks.name: Vals Science Index

benchmarks.description: JavaScript issue resolution where bug reports depend on screenshots, evaluated by Vals AI with no agent internet access.
benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Multimodal (Vals)

benchmarks.description: Agent evaluation on research-grade US tax questions using the Tax Agent Bench harness.
benchmarks.name: Tax Agent Bench

benchmarks.description: A Vals-hosted view of Terminal-Bench 1.0 with easy, medium, and hard task splits.
benchmarks.name: Vals Terminal-Bench 1.0 mirror

benchmarks.description: Vals AI’s independent run of the Terminal-Bench 4.0 frontier terminal suite, with per-domain splits.
benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0 (Vals)

benchmarks.description: Vals AI’s fixed-harness, single-trial run of 70 expert-authored scientific research workflows.
benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench Science (Vals)

benchmarks.description: A Vals AI agent benchmark that gives each system five days to build and run a space program in Kerbal Space Program.
benchmarks.name: Time Horizon Index: KSP

benchmarks.description: A Vals AI comparison of native provider search and Exa across finance-analysis and legal-research tasks.
benchmarks.name: Web Search Index

benchmarks.description: Tests long-horizon coherence by asking agents to operate a simulated vending-machine business for one year.
benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2

benchmarks.description: Vals.ai benchmark for evaluating whether models can build complete web applications from natural language specifications in a production-like development environment.
benchmarks.name: Vibe Code Bench

benchmarks.description: Can a model extend one working web application across a long sequence of dependent requests?
benchmarks.name: Vibe Code Bench 1-100

benchmarks.description: A repo-level code generation and full-project delivery benchmark spanning web, mobile, and simulation-style implementation tasks.
benchmarks.name: VIBE-Pro

benchmarks.description: A display-only MiniMax provider benchmark for end-to-end coding-agent and product-building tasks.
benchmarks.name: VIBE V2

benchmarks.description: A comprehensive benchmark for multimodal large language models on video understanding, covering temporal reasoning, perception, and question answering over videos.
benchmarks.name: Video-MME

benchmarks.description: A stricter Video-MME setting that removes subtitle help and tests video understanding from visual and audio context alone.
benchmarks.name: Video-MME (w/o subtitle)

benchmarks.description: A video understanding benchmark that allows subtitle access when answering multimodal questions about videos.
benchmarks.name: Video-MME (with subtitle)

benchmarks.description: A video extension of MMMU-style multimodal reasoning over expert questions grounded in temporal media.
benchmarks.name: VideoMMMU

benchmarks.description: A benchmark for converting visual references into functional web implementations.
benchmarks.name: Vision2Web

benchmarks.description: An interactive real-world agent benchmark grounded in practical consumer-service tasks such as delivery, in-store consumption, and online travel workflows.
benchmarks.name: VITA-Bench

benchmarks.description: Tests whether speech-to-text models preserve exact structured values in English workplace audio.
benchmarks.name: VoiceCodeBench

benchmarks.description: A live human-preference benchmark where language models turn text prompts into voxel structures and voters compare anonymous builds from the same prompt.
benchmarks.name: VoxelBench Text

benchmarks.description: A live human-preference benchmark where multimodal models build voxel structures from image references and voters compare anonymous results produced from the same prompt.
benchmarks.name: VoxelBench Image

benchmarks.description: A speech-recognition benchmark on the cleaned Artificial Analysis VoxPopuli subset, reported as word error rate where lower is better.
benchmarks.name: VoxPopuli WER

benchmarks.description: A vision-centric benchmark for high-level multimodal reasoning and perception quality.
benchmarks.name: V*

benchmarks.description: An open software-engineering benchmark built from real merged post-cutoff pull requests across Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Go repositories.
benchmarks.name: VulcanBench v3

benchmarks.description: A post-cutoff software-engineering benchmark with hidden functional tests and regression guards, reported for vendor coding-agent harnesses.
benchmarks.name: VulcanBench CII v1

benchmarks.description: A lighter multilingual benchmark slice published in provider tables for broad cross-lingual transfer and understanding.
benchmarks.name: VWT2k-lite

benchmarks.description: WebArena tests whether a browser-agent system can complete 812 long-horizon tasks inside self-hosted replicas of functional websites. It checks the requested end state, so a result reflects the model, agent scaffold, browser interface, action budget, and evaluator together—not the base model alone.
benchmarks.name: WebArena

benchmarks.description: WebArena-Verified is an audited release of the WebArena browser-agent benchmark. It rechecks task descriptions, reference answers, and evaluators, and replaces nondeterministic judging with deterministic checks where possible.
benchmarks.name: WebArena-Verified

benchmarks.description: Coding agents recreate nine reference web apps from an empty directory. Plato checks visual and functional behavior through end-to-end workflows.
benchmarks.name: Web Clone Bench

benchmarks.description: A browser-agent benchmark for completing multi-step workflows on live websites.
benchmarks.name: WebVoyager

benchmarks.description: A machine-learning engineering benchmark that tests whether LLMs can train models on novel datasets, write PyTorch code, and improve through iterative feedback.
benchmarks.name: WeirdML

benchmarks.description: A multimodal math benchmark for visually grounded mathematical reasoning and answer generation.
benchmarks.name: We-Math

benchmarks.description: NVIDIA multi-turn version of When2Call that tests whether a model calls a tool, asks a follow-up question, or abstains.
benchmarks.name: When2Call Multi-Turn

benchmarks.description: A broad research-agent benchmark for open-ended information gathering, synthesis, and answer construction across wide search spaces.
benchmarks.name: WideResearch

benchmarks.description: An automated evaluation framework using 1,000+ real-world user tasks covering reasoning, planning, coding, and creative writing. Highly correlated with Chatbot Arena human preference rankings.
benchmarks.name: WildBench

benchmarks.description: A commonsense coreference benchmark reported in DeepSeek-V4 base-model evaluations.
benchmarks.name: WinoGrande

benchmarks.description: Machine-translation quality on the WMT26 general translation task, averaged across all evaluated languages and scored 0-100 by an LLM judge.
benchmarks.name: WMT26

benchmarks.description: A forced-answer WorldVQA variant for atomic visual world knowledge.
benchmarks.name: WorldVQA ForceAnswer

benchmarks.description: WritingBench evaluates generative writing across six domains. This dated benchmark-owner table contains 54 source model rows, with overall and domain scores on the native 0-100 scale.
benchmarks.name: WritingBench

benchmarks.description: Moonshot AI's internal benchmark of expert-curated, source-code-based vulnerability discovery and exploitation tasks, most reproducing recently disclosed vulnerabilities with mitigations enabled.
benchmarks.name: xdev-bench-hard

benchmarks.description: A Z.AI benchmark for OpenClaw-style agent workflows spanning information search, office work, data analysis, development and operations, automation, and security.
benchmarks.name: ZClawBench

benchmarks.description: A multi-step visual reasoning benchmark with pass@5 reporting and optional tool use.
benchmarks.name: ZeroBench

benchmarks.description: A Python-assisted ZeroBench_main evaluation reported as pass@5.
benchmarks.name: ZeroBench w/ Python
